Sam —

Appreciate the questions. Below is an exec-friendly summary addressing each point; I also attached a revised PDF with a one-page credit calculator table.

1) Uptime bands and credit math:
- 99.95% (SLA Tier A): targeted for core inference paths. Credit: 25% of monthly retainer for below-target occurrences per SLA schedule.
- 99.9% (SLA Tier B): default for non-core endpoints. Credit: 10% of monthly retainer.
- We can model the marginal cost: moving a subset of endpoints (up to 40% of token volume) from Tier B -> Tier A is ~6% incremental retainer in year-one pricing. See attached page 2 table.

2) Rolling coverage across regions:
- Handovers are scheduled windows; if an incident spans two regions during a handover, credits are not double-counted. Instead: credit is prorated by duration and primary region ownership (we define primary ownership per endpoint in the SOW). Quarterly true-ups reconcile any overlap and generate usage credits if double-coverage occurred.

3) Escalation & response commitments:
- P1: 1-hour ack target during retainer hours (24/7 with retainer); remediation SLA varies by incident type but we guarantee initial triage and a named on-call engineer within that window.
- P2: 4-hour ack target.
- We provide named escalation rosters (attached) and a 24/7 fallback roster for P1s — this is built into the retainer slab.

4) Pricing concession:
- We can offer a 10% first-year concession on the retainer if Acme commits to a 12-month prepay and agrees to the rolling coverage addendum. This concession is limited to the retainer portion (does not apply to metered overages or regional add-ons).

Next steps: If that structure sounds OK, we'll produce a short SOW addendum that calls out endpoint ownership, regional add-ons, and the quarterly true-up process. Suggest a 30-minute procurement + legal call Wed 10:00am PT.

I'll attach the revised proposal: Redwood_Retainer_Slab_Consolidated_Proposal_v3.pdf (updated page 2) and SLA_Rolling_Coverage_Rosters.xlsx (updated roster with fallback names).

Best,
Karthik
